newsitem.title: LEBANON: Israeli troops kill Hizbollah gunman in Lebanon.
newsitem.headline: Israeli troops kill Hizbollah gunman in Lebanon.

text.p: Israeli troops killed a pro-Iranian Hizbollah guerrilla and wounded three others north of Israel's occupation zone in south Lebanon, the Moslem group said on Saturday.

"A group of Israeli troops tried early on Saturday to infiltrate outside the zone toward the village of Zibqin when it clashed with our guerrillas at close distance. One of our brave fighters was killed and three were wounded," Hizbollah said in a statement.
"The Israeli group suffered several casualties," it said.
Earlier an Israeli military statement said its forces had killed one guerrilla, wounded several and suffered no casualties.
It brought to 12 the number of Hizbollah guerrillas killed in clashes with Israeli troops in south Lebanon this year. Nine Israeli soldiers were killed and 36 wounded in the same period.

The Israeli statement said: "An Israeli army force operating in the western sector north of the security zone in south Lebanon (on Friday) night killed one terrorist and injured several other terrorists. The Israeli forces suffered no casualties."

On May 15, pro-Iranian Hizbollah guerrillas killed three Israeli soldiers and wounded seven in a clash in south Lebanon. Israeli aircraft launched several attacks on south Lebanon over the next three days.
Hizbollah attacks Israeli forces and their militia allies in a bid to oust them from the 15 km (nine-mile) -wide occupation zone in south Lebanon.
